name: Dr. Mundo
title: the Madman of Zaun

Q.name: Infected Bonesaw
Q.description: Dr. Mundo hurls his bonesaw, dealing 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% current Health magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. If the bonesaw hits a champion or monster, Dr. Mundo restores (1 × 50/60/70/80/90) Health. If it hits a non-champion or non-monster, Dr. Mundo instead restores (0.5 × 50/60/70/80/90) Health.
Q.summary: Dr. Mundo throws an infected bonesaw, dealing damage to the first enemy hit based on their current health and slowing them.

W.name: Heart Zapper
W.description: Dr. Mundo charges up a defibrilator, dealing 20/35/50/65/80 magic damage each second for up to 3 seconds to nearby enemies. Additionally he stores 0.8–0.95 (by level) of damage taken for the first 0.75 seconds and 25% for the remaining duration as gray health and can Recast. Recast: Detonate the defibrilator, dealing 20/35/50/65/80 + 0.07×bonus max HP magic damage to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one champion, Dr. Mundo restores 100% of gray health, otherwise he instead restores 50% of gray health.
W.summary: Dr. Mundo electrocutes himself, dealing persistent damage to nearby enemies and storing a portion of damage he takes. At the end of the duration or on Recast, Dr. Mundo deals a burst of damage to nearby enemies. If the burst hit an enemy, he heals a percentage of the stored damage.

E.name: Blunt Force Trauma
E.description: Passive: Dr Mundo gains (2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2×max HP) × 0.01 Attack Damage. Active: Dr Mundo violently swings his "medical" bag, causing his next Attack to deal an additional 5/15/25/35/45 + 0.05×bonus max HP physical damage, increased by up to 1.4 + -1 based on his missing Health. If the enemy is killed, Mundo swats them away, dealing 5/15/25/35/45 + 0.05×bonus max HP physical damage to enemies they pass through.
E.summary: Passive - Dr. Mundo gains bonus Attack Damage, increasing based on his max Health. Active - Dr. Mundo slams his “medical” bag into an enemy, dealing additional damage based on his missing Health. If the enemy dies they are swatted away, dealing damage to enemies they pass through.

R.name: Maximum Dosage
R.description: Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, gaining 15/20/25% of his missing Health as max Health, 15/25/35% Move Speed, and regenerating 20/40/60% max Health over 10 seconds. At Rank 3, both healing effects are increased by an additional 5% per nearby enemy champion.
R.summary: Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, instantly healing a percent of his missing Health. He then gains Move Speed and regenerates a portion of his maximum Health over a long duration.

Passive.name: Goes Where He Pleases
Passive.description: Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby. Dr. Mundo can pick it up by walking over it, restoring Health and reducing this Ability's Cooldown. Dr. Mundo also has significantly increased Health regeneration.
Passive.summary: Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby. Dr. Mundo can pick it up by walking over it, restoring Health and reducing this Ability's Cooldown. Dr. Mundo also has significantly increased Health regeneration.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Unkillable juggernaut who ignores the first immobilizing effect with his passive, throws cleavers and regens through fights with R.
strengths: Q cleaver poke + slow from range
Passive ignores first immobilizing crowd control
profile.curveNote: Farms with Q and sustains; fights after 6.

Passive.notes: Resists the first immobilizing effect; drops a canister.

Q.notes: Cleaver: damage based on current health, slows first hit.

W.notes: Damage around him, stores damage taken, heals on recast.

E.notes: Empowered attack (bag slam), more damage with missing health.

R.notes: Heal missing health, move speed, regen.

profile.windowAgainst: Passive canister down (immobilizing works) and before 6.
